rationale: Monotonic Volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage violations. At low voltage (0.90-0.95 pu), the curve injects reactive power to raise voltage. At nominal voltage (1.0 pu), no reactive power is injected. At high voltage (1.05-1.10 pu), the curve absorbs reactive power to lower voltage. All q_fraction values respect inverter reactive-power capability and the curve maintains strict monotonicity with non-increasing q_fraction as voltage increases.
